title: IELTS Academic Writing Task 2: Urban Transport and Congestion Pricing
prompt: In many large cities, traffic congestion has become a serious problem, and some governments are considering charging drivers a fee to enter the city centre during busy hours. Discuss the advantages and disadvantages of introducing such congestion charges, and recommend two measures that city authorities could combine with the charge to make the policy fairer and more effective for residents. Write at least 250 words.
instructions: 本题为模拟练习，所有场景与数据均为虚构，并非官方雅思试题。请先仔细阅读题目，明确要求讨论拥堵收费的优点与缺点，并提出两项配套措施。写作时请确保立场清晰、论证充分，并使用具体例子支持观点；建议用约5分钟规划、30分钟写作、5分钟检查。全文不少于250词，注意段落结构与衔接。
